text:
Maria Chen: Quick ask — we need to schedule a PIR for the RWinf-504 noisy eviction incident from last night. Who can facilitate? Prefer someone on-call-friendly; aiming for a 45m slot this week. I'll assemble pre-read.

Devon Patel: I can facilitate Wed 09:30 PT / Thu 01:30 UTC (works for me). Happy to cover timeline + mitigations.

Sam Lee: I can attend and run customer-impact section. Have the support ticket notes.

Anika Rao: I'm OOO Wed afternoon but can do Thurs morning UTC. Also can own action tracker post-meeting.

Maria Chen: Thanks. Thinking agenda: 1) timeline 2) impact 3) mitigation decisions 4) action items. Need someone to post runbook snippet and the infra logs.

incident-bot: PIR created: INC-2026-145 — owners: Maria, Devon. Calendar invite link: https://redwood.app/pir/INC-2026-145

Devon Patel: Proposed slots (please react): 
• Thu 08:30 PT / Thu 15:30 UTC
• Thu 11:00 PT / Thu 18:00 UTC
• Fri 09:00 PT / Fri 16:00 UTC

Maria Chen: @Anika Rao can you confirm action-owner template and whether we want a separate QA-only session? :thinking_face: 

Anika Rao: Confirmed. I'll prepare the action tracker template and add an "owner, due date, verification steps" column. No separate QA session unless action count >4.

Sam Lee: I'll paste customer-impact notes in the thread soon.

Sam Lee: Customer impacted: 3 enterprise customers experienced elevated latency for 12-30m. Support created ticket 12345, customer A had visible SLA breach. I'll attach excerpts to the pre-read.

Devon Patel: For the runbook, use the "eviction-mitigation" steps — copy below:
```
1) check node health
2) drain node if CPU > 90%
3) bump reservation for critical-pool
4) route traffic to fallback region
```

Maria Chen: I'll send calendar poll in 10m, and ping folks once slots lock. Goal: facilitator identified and invite + pre-read sent 48h before the PIR. If we can't get 48h, we'll do 24h with pre-read flagged "required".

Anika Rao: I'll claim post-PIR action tracker ownership. Devon, can you facilitate slides + timeline?

Devon Patel: Yep — I'll draft slides and a short timeline doc and upload to the PIR page.

incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: PIR meeting INC-2026-145 will be created when a slot receives >=2 reactions.

Maria Chen: Thanks team. I'll also loop in support lead @Jordan Martinez for the customer-facing notes.

Jordan Martinez: Added. I'll bring the support timeline and customer comms draft.

Maria Chen: Last note — anyone in APAC who needs to present, ping me, we can record. :wave:
